criteria.text: Nested keys use double underscore syntax: APP_DB__HOST sets db.host

evidence: independent run of `npm test` passed (7 passed)

[model] The code uses `.split('__')` on the APP_-stripped env var name to parse nested paths. The setPath() helper function creates intermediate objects as needed. The test 'overrides nested keys using double underscore' confirms APP_DB__HOST='db.internal' correctly produces {db: {host: 'db.internal'}}. Independent test run shows all 7 tests passing.

grader.evidence: Key name is split on '__' and each segment lowercased (src/load.js:32-35), then setPath (src/load.js:10-18) walks/creates intermediate objects. Probe: APP_DB__HOST='h' on {"db":{"host":"lh","port":5432}} -> {db:{host:'h',port:5432}} (sibling preserved). Segments that would be empty (e.g. APP___PROTO__) are skipped at src/load.js:36, so no prototype pollution — probe confirmed ({}).polluted stayed undefined for both APP___PROTO__ and APP_A____PROTO__.
